notes: BLOCKING: The manifest assignment requires native ETH as pairedCurrency, but HackathonMachine.beforeInitialize accepts only the launch token paired with its immutable IMD token, 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7. The declared ETH/HACK pool will revert with WrongPool, including when initialized by $factory. The hook accepts fee 12500 and tickSpacing 60 for IMD/HACK only. This pairing conflict requires implementation/policy review before deployment; a manifest cannot resolve it. initialPrice is the explicitly supplied decimal sqrtPriceX96, 125270724187523965593206900, originally specified for the 2500 IMD opening cap; it does not establish an ETH opening cap. Ethereum mainnet, chainId 1. HackToken is TONOFHACKATHONS (HACK), 18 decimals, with a fixed 1000000000-token supply minted to its deployer and no owner, further minting, pause or upgrade. HackathonMachine combines the hook and weekly prize machine; no additional contracts or external library deployments are required. Constructor arguments follow the implementation: PoolManager, paying-wallet owner, launch factory, launch token, IMD token, IMD attester. Permissions encode flags 0x20cc. The implementation collects an additional 2% IMD swap fee as redeemable PoolManager claims for the prize pot, separate from the pool's 1.25% LP fee and the factory's 1% launcher fee. Anyone can redeem fee claims. Weekly rounds use Monday epoch 345600; entry fees default to 10 IMD. Settlement first pays the submitter 1% of the pot, with a 5 IMD minimum when affordable, then splits the remainder by default into 70% streamed over 28 days, 10% winner-token purchase with slippage limits or stream fallback, and 20% carry. Unsettled rounds roll over. The owner pins questionHash once; signer/domain-version changes have a 7-day timelock and deny additions a 48-hour delay. Entry pause does not pause claims or results. No staking, owner withdrawal or upgrade path. docs/heartbeat.json and docs/schedule.json describe Mondays 01:00 UTC, a fixed deployment-block window, and panel 7/quorum 5. Supply allocation, including the requested poolBps 9000 of the launcher share and remainder to the paying wallet, is controlled by the separate launch policy/request, not this manifest. No deployment, broadcast, pinning or RPC call is authorized by this file.
